claims.why: the DEL of the rectangle rule is the Stormer-Verlet recurrence
TRAP: explicit Euler (q' = p/m, p' = -kq, eliminated to two steps) evaluates the force at x_0, not x_1; it is not the DEL of this L_d
the rectangle-rule L_d is first order as a one-step map (symplectic Euler) but its two-step DEL is Stormer-Verlet, centred and second order
TRAP: the exact order of the DEL is 2, not 1 (the h^1 coefficient vanishes identically)
order at least 1: the DEL is second order, so it is in particular first-order consistent
